The '''Zealots of Psusan''' were a trendy religious cult that dominated three colonies on the [[Talcene Transit/Legends|Talcene Transit]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]]. Disciples of the cult also established colonies in the [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. By [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the [[High Priest/Legends|High Priest]] of the cult, [[Scri Oscuro]], was put in [[Prison/Legends|prison]] by [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Kalyn Farnmir/Legends|Kalyn Farnmir]] and her partner [[Cian Shee/Legends|Cian Shee]] after former cult members discovered his illicit ventures. From prison, Oscuro lured Shee to work for him in his plot to enact vengeance on Farnmir.

While on the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in 22 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|BBY]], Farnmir was notified of the plot by an [[Information broker/Legends|informant]], and she arranged a meeting between her and Shee at the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]]. Acting like nothing was wrong while at the club, Farnmir attempted to capture Shee while they left, but she was able to escape and call off the deal between her and Oscuro.

==Description==
The Zealots of Psusan were a trendy, [[Gender/Legends|female]]-empowering<ref name="Far Horizons">''[[Far Horizons]]''</ref> religious<ref name="CSWEZealots" /> cult<ref name="Kalyn Farnmir">{{DB|character|kalynfarnmir|Farnmir, Kalyn}}</ref> led by a [[High Priest (Psusan)|High Priest]].<ref name="CSWEScri">{{CSWECite|II|426|Oscuro, Scri}}</ref> The Zealots dominated three colonies along the [[Talcene Transit/Legends|Talcene Transit]], a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] that went through the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]], a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] along the Talcene Transit, exported [[Plant/Legends|root]] segments from the [[Bubse tree/Legends|bubse tree]] and [[Mineral/Legends|mineral]] [[Water/Legends|water]], both of which fetched high prices from aesthetes of the cult.<ref name="TEA" /> A starburst<ref name="WhosWho">{{InsiderCite|75|Who's Who in the Outlander Club: It's Ladies' Night}}</ref> [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoo]] located on the abdomen was associated with<ref name="CSWEZealots" /> and represented<ref name="RoshaVess">{{DB|character|roshavess|Vess, Rosha}}</ref> the Zealots.<ref name="CSWEZealots" />

==History==
===Colonizing cult===
[[File:Coruscant-EotE.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The Zealots of Psusan became fashionable on Coruscant (pictured).]]
Members of the Zealots were among the many disciples of various religious groups that established countless colonies in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] area of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], particularly in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]]. Freedom from religious persecution was a large incentive for these colonization efforts, though most of these colonies faded [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later.<ref name="Core" /> 

During the [[Great Peace of the Republic|last years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the cult had become fashionable on<ref name="CSWEZealots" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] planet<ref name="TEA" /> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="CSWEZealots" /> Prior to the start of the<ref name="CSWEScri" /> [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]],<ref name="Clone Wars">{{CSWECite|I|131|Clone Wars}}</ref> the Zealots were led by the corrupt High Priest [[Scri Oscuro]].<ref name="CSWEScri" /> By [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}} to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref><ref name="KhaleenDate">[[Republic 49|''Republic'' 49]] is set shortly before the [[First Battle of Kamino]], which {{FactFile2014|6|22 BBY 75-80|Dark Side Influence}} dates to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> the cult was fast growing<ref name="Complete Locations">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> and the [[Human/Legends|Human]] women<ref name="NyratAgira" /><ref name="RoshaVess" /><ref name="Fact File 113">{{FactFile|113|HEN 1-2|Khaleen Hentz}}</ref> [[Nyrat Agira/Legends|Nyrat Agira]], [[Rosha Vess]], and [[Khaleen Hentz/Legends|Khaleen Hentz]] were members of the cult, bearing its associated tattoo.<ref name="RoshaVess" /><ref name="NyratAgira">{{DB|character|nyratagira|Agira, Nyrat}}</ref><ref name="CSWEZealots" /> By that year as well,<ref name="DBdate">The events in [[Kalyn Farnmir/Legends|Kalyn Farnmir's]] [[Databank (original)|Databank]] entry show the apprehension of [[Scri Oscuro]] by Farnmir and [[Cian Shee/Legends|Cian Shee]] happen before the events of {{Film|II}}, which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> Oscuro had started to use the church<ref name="Kalyn Farnmir" /> and his position of spiritual influence as a front for illegal ventures. When former members of the cult discovered this, a bounty was placed on his head that was claimed by<ref name="CSWEScri" /> the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Kalyn Farnmir/Legends|Kalyn Farnmir]] and her partner, the [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] [[Cian Shee/Legends|Cian Shee]].<ref name="Kalyn Farnmir" />

===Revenge against Kalyn Farnmir===
[[File:KalynFarnmir1.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Scri Oscuro sought to enact vengeance against Kalyn Farnmir (pictured).]]
Oscuro tried from [[Prison/Legends|prison]] to use his cult contacts to enact revenge on Shee and Farnmir and was able to lure the slicer to work for him through a<ref name="CSWEScri" /> hefty payout<ref name="Kalyn Farnmir" /> of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="CSWEScri" /> During one [[Local day/Legends|night]] on Coruscant<ref name="Kalyn Farnmir" /> in 22 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|BBY]],<ref name="DBDate">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}} to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. The events in [[Kalyn Farnmir/Legends|Kalyn Farnmir's]] [[Databank (original)|Databank]] entry show Agira's interrogation happening shortly before Farnmir meeting [[Cian Shee/Legends|Cian Shee]], which is shown in the film. Therefore, the events in the Databank entry must take place in 22 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> Farnmir was told by an [[Information broker/Legends|informant]] that sinister parts of the Zealots were planning on taking her down and that Shee was in on the plot. Shaken by the news and knowing that the cult was popular in Coruscant's entertainment districts, the bounty hunter arranged a meeting with Shee at the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]],<ref name="Kalyn Farnmir" /> an [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District]] [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] hall and [[Nightclub/Legends|nightclub]].<ref name="CSWE2">{{CSWECite|II|431|Outlander Club}}</ref> 

Farnmir arrived first to the club, noticing many cult signs. Nyrat Agira was also visiting at that time, and the bounty hunter interrogated her<ref name="Kalyn Farnmir" /> after noticing her tattoo.<ref name="NyratAgira" /> Agira was able to confirm that Scri Oscuro was present on Coruscant and that he had dealings with Shee. When the slicer arrived at the club, Farnmir acted like nothing was wrong.<ref name="Kalyn Farnmir" /> After the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|apprehended]] bounty hunter [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]] there,<ref name="aotc">{{Film|II}}</ref> Agira identified a [[Unidentified weak-minded individual/Legends|weak-minded individual]] for conversion to the cult.<ref name="Complete Locations" /> Farnmir tried to capture Shee while they were leaving the club, but the slicer's reflexes allowed her to escape. Now aware that her former partner was expecting to be ambushed, Shee called off the deal with Oscuro. The slicer was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by Farnmir on<ref name="Kalyn Farnmir" /> the [[Moon/Legends|moon]]<ref name="Shaddaa">{{DB|location|narshaddaa|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref> [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]<ref name="Kalyn Farnmir" /> at some point during or after [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]].<ref name="TFU">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]'', which includes the [[Corellian Treaty|formation]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], to [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]]. Therefore, [[Cian Shee/Legends|Cian Shee's]] [[Death/Legends|death]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] in [[Kalyn Farnmir/Legends|Kalyn Farnmir's]] [[Databank (original)|Databank]] entry must happen during or after that year, as Farnmir is associated with the Alliance when she kills Shee.</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Zealots of Psusan were first indirectly mentioned in the reference book ''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary]]'', which was written by [[David West Reynolds (real person)|David West Reynolds]]<ref name="AOTC VD2">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> and released on [[April 23]], [[2002]].<ref name="VDRelease2">{{SWArchive|url=eu/lit/ref/news20020227.html|text=Book Preview: DK Episode II Books}}</ref> The cult members Nyrat Agira and Rosha Vess first appeared in an illustration in the young readers book ''[[Jango Fett: Bounty Hunter]]'', written by [[Eric Arnold]] and illustrated by [[Valerie Reckert]]<ref name="Jango Fett: Bounty Hunter">''[[Jango Fett: Bounty Hunter]]''</ref> and also released on April 23 of that year.<ref name="Amazon">{{SWArchive|url=eu/lit/young/news20020225.html|text=Book Preview: Episode II Children's Books}}</ref> The image of the members was taken from the then-upcoming [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']],<ref name="aotc" /> released on [[May 16]], 2002.<ref name="YbY">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, Updated and Expanded Edition]]''</ref> The Zealots of Psusan were first identified in [[2003]] with the release of ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Attack of the Clones]]'', a reference book by [[Simon Beecroft]] and [[Curtis Saxton]].<ref name="Inside">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Attack of the Clones]]''</ref>
